title: Clean & Convenient (Bags Beat Bins For Sure!)
text:
Clean & Convenient (Bags Beat Bins For Sure!). First, I think Oreck deserves a lot of very high praise for being the first to make one of these types of cordless vacuums that have a bag (which they call a Pod, of course). I hate the collection bin-type of vacuums because I do not like the mess and dust inside the collection bins.

At the occasional $399 discounted-by-Oreck price, I give this Oreck Pod Vacuum 5 stars because it is a bagged cordless, which means no mess and dirt and dust inside a collection bin you constantly see and frequently have to clean. When this vacuum is sold at its full retail $569 price, I will deduct 1 star because I feel it's too expensive at that high price.

I also deduct 1 star because this vac cannot be used with the a/c cord plugged in. If the battery power is depleted (or if in the future the battery no longer can hold a charge), the vacuum becomes absolutely useless. It would have been really nice if we had the option of running the vac with the power cord plugged in just as a backup.

One more negative: The soft bristle brush easily sheds its bristles--and the bristles easily become deformed--by just running the brush lightly over bed sheets or a soft blanket, etc. (And you might want to use this cordless vac on those types of things to vacuum up hair, etc. I have received multiple replacement brushes from Oreck just in case the one I received was an anomaly, but they all do the same shedding thing as mentioned, and quite badly.

This cordless vacuum is lightweight, and it has good suction. It is convenient to use on stairs, and on bathroom and kitchen floors. On low or no pile carpets it also works well. On medium to high pile carpets it is not as easy to push and pull, but it works well.

If you dislike dirty vacuum collection bins and if the price is in your budget, this Oreck Pod Cordless Vacuum is certainly worth considering...and assuming you do not get a defective one, you'll probably be happy you purchased it.
